附件尚未上传完成，请等待连接恢复，或重试、移除失败附件: Attachments are not fully uploaded yet. Wait for the connection to recover, or retry or remove the failed attachments.
复制出一个新会话，原会话不动: Create a new session as a copy, leaving the original unchanged.
该操作需要你确认后才能继续。: This action requires your confirmation before it can continue.
改哪里 (点击任意代码行可引用微调): Where to change (click any code line to quote for fine-tuning)
高风险设置：让与当前 DSH 版本不兼容的插件包强行启用。只在明确知道后果时使用: High-risk setting: force-enable plugin packages incompatible with the current DSH version. Use only when you understand the consequences.
管理的是网关所连 DSH profile 的插件，不是手机本地。开关与卸载会实时:
This manages plugins for the DSH profile the gateway is connected to, not the phone itself. Toggles and uninstalls affect the desktop app in real time.
        Disabling dsh-plugin-mobile-gateway itself will disconnect the phone; you can only re-enable it from DSH Web.
还没有拿到安装 ID。: Install ID has not been received yet.
会话没建成，文字已复制到剪贴板: Session not created; text copied to clipboard.
会话跑起来之后目录就固定了，选错了只能重新建: Once a session is running, its directory is fixed. If you choose wrong, you can only create a new session.
会话页出了点问题: Something went wrong with the session page
会话已经开始过，模式已固定；想换模式请新建会话: This session has already started and its mode is fixed; create a new session to switch modes.
检测到远端修改，建议关闭后重读再保存。: Remote changes detected. Close, reload, and save again.
建会话超时，重试一下: Session creation timed out, try again
建会话超时了，再点一次「新建会话」: Session creation timed out; tap 'New session' again.
进专门的选择页，拖手柄挑任意片段: Open a dedicated selection page and drag the handles to pick any part.
静默规律运行 · 仅在异常时通知你: Runs quietly on a schedule · Notifies you only on errors
离线：这次审批没发出去，重连后请重新决定: Offline: this approval wasn't sent; decide again after reconnecting.
历史加载超时，点「重试」重新加载: History loading timed out; tap 'Retry' to reload.
立即插入当前轮次: Insert into the current turn immediately
例如 @scope/dsh-plugin-xxx 或本地绝对路径: e.g. @scope/dsh-plugin-xxx or a local absolute path
连不上网关：手机网络或代理阻断了连接。请关闭 VPN/代理后重试；仍失败请检查: Cannot reach the gateway: your phone's network or proxy is blocking the connection. Disable VPN/proxy and retry; if it still fails, check Wi-Fi/cellular.
连接断开，重连后会自动加载历史: Disconnected; history will load automatically once reconnected.
连接断了，文字已复制到剪贴板: Connection lost; text copied to clipboard.
连接断了，转写没完成，重连后再试: Connection lost; transcription didn't finish, try again after reconnecting.
连接可能已中断，重连后请确认最终状态。: The connection may have dropped; confirm the final state after reconnecting.
连接网关超时：请检查手机网络/VPN/代理后重试；配对码可能仍在有效期内。: Gateway connection timed out: check your phone's network/VPN/proxy and retry; the pairing code may still be valid.
连接已断开，重连后会自动加载历史: Disconnected; history will load automatically once reconnected.
连接已建立但配对未完成：配对码可能已被使用或过期。请在服务器上重新生成配对码后重: Connection established but pairing incomplete: the pairing code may have been used or expired. Regenerate it on the server and pair again.
没发出去，检查网络后再试: Not sent; check your network and try again.
没收到网关回执，检查网络后再试: No gateway acknowledgment received; check your network and try again.
命令详情不可用，请到 Web UI 确认后再决定: Command details unavailable; confirm in the Web UI before deciding.
命令详情不可用。请到 Web UI 确认这条命令后再决定。: Command details are unavailable. Confirm this command in the Web UI before deciding.
模型这次没有给出选项，直接在下面输入答案即可。: The model didn't offer any options this time. Enter your answer below.
排队消息没有改成，可能已经开始执行了: The queued message wasn't changed; it may already be running.
配对码已过期，请在 WebUI 重新生成: Pairing code has expired; regenerate it in WebUI.
配对内容不是合法 Base64URL（不能包含 = 或空格）: Pairing content is not valid Base64URL (must not contain = or spaces)
配对内容解码后不是 JSON: Decoded pairing content is not JSON
配对内容里没有安全的连接地址：公网明文 ws:// 已拦截，请用 wss://: No safe connection address in pairing content: public plaintext ws:// is blocked; re-pair using wss:// or a LAN address.
配对内容缺少配对码: Pairing content is missing the pairing code
配对内容缺少有效的 WebSocket 地址: Pairing content is missing a valid WebSocket address
配置节缺少 revision，无法安全写入。: Config section is missing a revision; cannot write safely.
